notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
